reference.operation: Popover/Popconfirm align, builtinPlacements and onPopupAlign. Fixed popup160x80 and anchor boxes isolate geometry. Changed source geometry is captured after explicit forceAlign; beforeForceAlign records the preceding two-frame state. Resize uses ResizeObserver. Custom/empty maps, points, percentage/parseFloat offsets, overflow, htmlRegion, dynamicInset, alias class order and semantic root/arrow priority. Avatar.Group forwarding uses fixed overflow bounds. Native automatic tracking, fixed/top-layer and viewport/transform boundaries remain explicit.
